quest.title: Absolutely Unique Delicacy
quest.description: Tang Wen seems to have lost her appetite after eating something strange...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Ah... I'm so hungry... I don't feel good...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: I-I'm not sure... I just feel quite sluggish.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: It was probably last night, when I brought home and ate that gourmet meal you made.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Although that dish was... quite special, but it at least filled my stomach.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: I then wanted to have a good night's sleep and work well today, but...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Every time I'm about to fall asleep, the interesting smell of that dish suddenly came back up from the pit of my stomach! It instantly woke me up.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: This cycle then continued, and I lay half-asleep until the sun came up...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: It's not a big deal if it's just having less sleep. I occasionally have to work overtime in the past...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: The main point is what happened today! I thought I would be fine after I got up and ate something, but I didn't expect that even when I ate something, the taste of yesterday's dish still lingers in my mouth...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that dish so powerful...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: *sigh* I think...only a dish with a unique flavor can wash away that interesting taste...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Dish with a unique flavor? Why don't we go around and ask others if they know of such a dish?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then we can make one for Miss Tang Wen... Maybe that will solve her problem!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Really? That's great, thank you so much! If-if it's convenient, please head to Ritou and ask...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: I remember... Li Xiao, a merchant of Ritou, is very knowledgeable about food, and Qiuyue of the Chuyu Trading Company, she can also be considered as an amateur gourmet!

dialogues.speaker: Li Xiao
dialogues.text: What's the matter? Ah... Miss Tang Wen.

dialogues.speaker: Li Xiao
dialogues.text: Loss of appetite... A strange taste in your mouth... Needs a special delicacy to salvage this situation?

dialogues.speaker: Li Xiao
dialogues.text: She actually met with such a difficulty... That's really quite tricky.

dialogues.speaker: Li Xiao
dialogues.text: But in my opinion, it doesn't have to be a particularly expensive dish. As long as the taste and flavor is unique, and it packs a punch, that should be enough...

dialogues.speaker: Li Xiao
dialogues.text: I suggest Jueyun Guoba! It has both a unique crunchy texture and a strong spicy flavor...

dialogues.speaker: Li Xiao
dialogues.text: It's been more than ten years since I first tasted Jueyun Guoba at Qingce Village, and I still think about it from time to time...

dialogues.speaker: Li Xiao
dialogues.text: I think if it's Jueyun Guoba, no matter what the problem is, it will be solved.

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: What is it? Hmm... Miss Tang Wen?

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: A strange taste in your mouth, loss of appetite, don't really want to eat anything?

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Is it really because she ate something strange? You're not mistaken, right?

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Why does it sound more like she's just bloated? Hmm, let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Forget it, since there is no way to judge, there is only one dish that I can recommend, and that is — Bamboo Shoot Soup!

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: The taste is savory, the meat is tender, and the flavor refreshing and appetizing. Most importantly, the soup can help in food digestion. Mmm! I wish I could have some right now.

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Believe me, all Tang Wen needs right now is Bamboo Shoot Soup!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, we got different answers. Both Jueyun Guoba and Bamboo Shoot Soup are special dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What should we do? Paimon's so torn!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you think, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You're asking Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If that's the case... If Paimon were to choose...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon will choose Grilled Tiger Fish!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Grilled Tiger Fish sounds very courageous. If Miss Tang Wen eats this courage, her troubles will be solved, right?

choices.text: Paimon, you sure know a lot about eating...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oops, that's why Paimon should let you decide.

choices.text: Hmm... The Delicious Jueyun Guoba it shall be!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woohoo! Let's quickly make this dish and bring it to Miss Tang Wen!

choices.text: Hmm... The Delicious Bamboo Shoot Soup it shall be!
Hmm... The Delicious Grilled Tiger Fish it shall be!
I don't think that's the story behind Tiger Fish...

talks.objective: Give the Delicious Jueyun Guoba to Tang Wen

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Oh, y'all are back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Miss Tang Wen, look what we brought back for you?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Hmm? What a unique aroma...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: I can't wait, please let me try it!

talks.objective: Give the Delicious Bamboo Shoot Soup to Tang Wen

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: This, this taste... A crisp texture, a rich fragrance, and flavor mixed with a hint of spice...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: The strange taste in my mouth has been washed away.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: It's so delicious! I never thought I would be able to taste such a delicacy in a foreign city...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, here's something for you. Please, you must take it.
